description.value:
Jar'Kai answers every problem with two blades instead of one, trusting that twin angles of attack will find a gap a single weapon never could. Its practitioners weave complementary strikes together, overwhelming a defense from two directions at once and rarely giving an opponent a moment to recover.

Versatility is the point: a Jar'Kai duelist reads the fight and adapts on the fly, switching which hand leads and which follows, until sheer weight of attacks breaks their opponent's composure entirely.
